evals.prompt: set up our registry retention and access policy
evals.expected_output: Defines an automated retention policy that never expires tags referenced by an active deployment, caps per-branch build history, and sweeps dangling manifests on a schedule, plus scopes push access to CI service identities only while pull access is scoped per-repository rather than a shared org-wide credential.

evals.prompt: production is suddenly running an old version of the image with no deploy on record
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that the deployment is likely pulling a mutable tag like latest that got overwritten by a later push, and recommends deploying by immutable identifier (git SHA, semver, or content digest) so every running deployment traces to one unchangeable image.

evals.prompt: can we just deploy straight off the :latest tag, saves retagging
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that latest is a mutable pointer that can change underneath a running deployment with no record of what shipped, and recommends tagging with an immutable identifier and deploying by that digest, keeping latest only as a human-facing convenience pointer.
